description: Loads active Statistics Canada vector-based macroeconomic indicators into PostgreSQL with optional selected indicators and batched concurrency.

parameters.name: indicators
parameters.label: Indicators
parameters.description: Optional Statistics Canada indicator codes. Leave blank to process the full configured catalogue.

parameters.name: concurrency
parameters.label: Concurrency
parameters.description: Maximum number of Statistics Canada indicators processed concurrently.

registration.confirmationText: This will call the Statistics Canada ingestion pipeline and write any new data into PostgreSQL.
